name: Occultus: Daughter of Darkness
source:
Occultus: Daughter of Darkness is a noir-inspired detective story with supernatural elements.

Join Private Detective Jane Malady in her search to find a missing woman which will drag her down into the murky underworld of L.A where cults and monsters rule supreme.

[From [url=https://bcg.itch.io/occultus-dod]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Occultus: Daughter of Darkness》是一则带有超自然元素、受黑色电影风格启发的侦探故事。

跟随私家侦探简·马拉迪，寻找一名失踪女性。这场调查，将把她拖入洛杉矶污浊的地下世界，那里由邪教与怪物主宰。

[摘自[url=https://bcg.itch.io/occultus-dod]Itch.io[/url]]
